$comment: THE SCHEME MASTER — every scheme the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment runs,
mapped to the people it serves (personas) and to what it provides (offerings).
This file is the single source for the service-discovery prototypes, the Figma option
frames and the decision deck. `tools/service-discovery/build-data.mjs` generates
`apps/hub/public/prototypes/service-discovery/data.js` and
`docs/research/dosje-scheme-master-2026-09.md` from it. Edit HERE, then rebuild.
SOURCES. Nothing in this file comes from the beta site's Schemes list, which the
8 September 2026 review found untrustworthy (it counts guideline pages, status tables
and State schemes as Department schemes). Every record cites at least one of:
AR    Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Annual Report 2025-26, Chapter 3
(socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/71441776233188.pdf), section number
SBE   Notes on Demands for Grants 2026-27, Demand No. 93 (indiabudget.gov.in/doc/eb/sbe93.pdf),
line item number
PIB   Year-End Review 2025 of the Department, PIB release 2209488, 29 December 2025
SJ    socialjustice.gov.in/schemes/<n> — the Department's legacy site scheme page
DOSJE dosje.gov.in organisation page, used only for portal names
RULES. A figure appears here only when a source states it. Where two sources disagree
the field is left empty and the disagreement is recorded in `conflicts`. Nothing here
states that a person IS eligible — `who` records whom the scheme names as its target
group; the sanctioning authority decides every application.

`offersFor` — where a record names more than one persona and not every offering applies to every one of them (a grant is for the NGO, the care is for the citizen), it says which personas each offering is for. Absent means every offering applies to every persona named.
ORDER. Personas are listed in the order the mandate names them (AR §1.2), then the three the schemes name: Students, Victims of Atrocities, Voluntary Organisations (instruction of 9 September 2026).

PORTAL. `personas[].portal` names the one persona-specific portal or helpline a One Tap band shows first, by route id; the link comes from `routes` and is shown only where `linkChecks.answered` lists it.

schemes.umbrella: Umbrella Scheme for Development of Scheduled Castes
schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Castes
schemes.provides: Compulsory non-refundable fees, including tuition, and an academic allowance for the whole course after Class X.
schemes.named: SC students studying at the post-matric stage; parent or guardian income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year.

schemes.umbrella: Umbrella Scheme for Development of Scheduled Castes
schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Castes and Others
schemes.provides: An academic allowance of ₹3,500 a year for day scholars and ₹7,000 or ₹8,000 for hostellers.
schemes.named: SC students in Class IX and X with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh; and children in Class I to X of manual scavengers, tanners and flayers, waste pickers and hazardous-cleaning workers, with no income limit.

schemes.name: National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.provides: A Ph.D. fellowship with contingency and house rent allowance; 2,000 new fellowships a year.
schemes.named: SC students who have qualified UGC NET-JRF or UGC-CSIR NET-JRF, for Ph.D. at a UGC-recognised institution.

schemes.name: National Overseas Scholarship for SCs and Others
schemes.provides: Tuition, maintenance and contingency allowances, visa, insurance and air passage for a Master's or Ph.D. abroad; 125 slots a year, 30% for women.
schemes.named: Students from Scheduled Castes, DNT, NT and SNT communities, landless agricultural labourers and traditional artisans; family income up to ₹8 lakh; age up to 35; admission to a top-500 QS-ranked university.

schemes.name: Top Class Education for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.provides: Full tuition and non-refundable charges, plus an academic allowance of ₹86,000 in the first year and ₹41,000 in each later year, at 274 notified institutions.
schemes.named: SC students with family income up to ₹8 lakh admitted to a notified institution; 30% of slots for SC girl students.

schemes.name: Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and PM CARES Children
schemes.provides: Course fee up to ₹75,000 and a stipend of ₹4,000 a month for up to 12 months of coaching for competitive and entrance examinations.
schemes.named: SC and OBC students with family income up to ₹8 lakh, and beneficiaries of the PM CARES for Children scheme with no income or caste condition.

schemes.name: SHRESHTA — Residential Education for Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas
schemes.provides: Mode I: full tuition and hostel fees at a top private residential school from Class 9 or 11 to Class 12. Mode II: grant-in-aid to NGO-run residential schools and hostels for SC students.
schemes.named: Meritorious SC students selected through the National Entrance Test for SHRESHTA; and voluntary organisations running schools and hostels for SC students.

schemes.umbrella: Umbrella Scheme for Development of Scheduled Castes
schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY)
schemes.provides: Development of SC-dominated villages as Adarsh Gram; grants-in-aid for district and State livelihood and infrastructure projects; hostels in higher-education institutions.
schemes.named: Scheduled Caste communities, through the State Government and District administration; 100% centrally funded.

schemes.umbrella: Umbrella Scheme for Development of Scheduled Castes
schemes.name: Implementation of the PCR Act, 1955 and the SC/ST (PoA) Act, 1989
schemes.provides: Relief and rehabilitation of atrocity victims and their dependants; an incentive for inter-caste marriages where one spouse is a Scheduled Caste; SC/ST Protection Cells, special police stations and exclusive special courts.
schemes.named: Victims of atrocities under the two Acts, and their dependants, through the State Government.

schemes.name: National Helpline Against Atrocities — 14566
schemes.provides: A toll-free, round-the-clock helpline in Hindi, English and regional languages that registers complaints under the PoA Act and follows them to an FIR.
schemes.named: Anyone reporting an atrocity against a member of a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe.

schemes.name: NCSC e-Grievance Management Portal
schemes.provides: Lodging and tracking of a complaint about deprivation of the rights and safeguards of Scheduled Castes, with SMS and e-mail updates at each stage.
schemes.named: Any member of a Scheduled Caste with a grievance about a safeguard.

schemes.name: National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE)
schemes.provides: Profiling and a NAMASTE card; PPE kits and safety training; health cover under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY; capital subsidy for sanitation vehicles and equipment under Swachhta Udyami Yojana; skill training with stipend for manual scavengers and dependants.
schemes.named: Sewer and septic tank workers, waste pickers, and manual scavengers and their dependants.

schemes.name: NSKFDC Concessional Loans
schemes.provides: Concessional loans for income-generating activities and education, with priority to women through Mahila Samridhi Yojana and Mahila Adhikarita Yojana.
schemes.named: Safai Karamcharis including waste pickers, manual scavengers, and their dependants.

schemes.name: National Commission for Safai Karamcharis
schemes.provides: Investigation of grievances of Safai Karamcharis, and pursuit of compensation in sewer and septic tank death and disability cases.
schemes.named: Safai Karamcharis and the families of sewer and septic tank workers.

schemes.name: NSFDC Concessional Loans
schemes.provides: Micro finance up to ₹1.40 lakh, term loans up to ₹50 lakh and education loans up to ₹40 lakh at concessional interest, through State Channelising Agencies and banks.
schemes.named: Scheduled Caste families within the Corporation's income ceiling.

schemes.name: NBCFDC Concessional Loans
schemes.provides: Individual loans up to ₹25 lakh, group loans up to ₹25 lakh per self-help group, and education loans up to ₹25 lakh at concessional interest.
schemes.named: Members of Backward Classes with annual family income up to ₹3 lakh.

schemes.name: VISVAS Yojana — Interest Subvention
schemes.provides: A 5% interest subvention, paid by direct benefit transfer, on income-generating loans up to ₹5 lakh for individuals and ₹10 lakh for self-help groups.
schemes.named: SC and OBC borrowers with family income up to ₹3 lakh, and Safai Karamcharis with no income limit, holding standard loan accounts.

schemes.name: Venture Capital Fund for SCs and for Backward Classes, with ASIIM
schemes.provides: Concessional finance from ₹10 lakh to ₹15 crore for SC enterprises and ₹20 lakh to ₹15 crore for Backward Class enterprises; equity up to ₹30 lakh for SC youth start-ups under ASIIM.
schemes.named: SC and Backward Class entrepreneurs and start-ups.

schemes.name: PM-DAKSH — Skill Training
schemes.provides: Free skill training, from up-skilling to long-term courses, with a stipend or boarding and lodging, and placement support.
schemes.named: Persons aged 18 to 45 from Scheduled Castes, DNTs and sanitation work with no income limit; OBCs with family income up to ₹3 lakh; EBCs up to ₹1 lakh.
schemes.note: SBE 11 records that the scheme is merged with PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana from 2026-27. The record stands for 2025-26 and must be reviewed before the surface launches.

schemes.name: Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens
schemes.provides: Grant-in-aid to organisations running senior citizen homes, continuous care homes and day-care centres that give free shelter, food, medical care and recreation.
schemes.named: Indigent senior citizens; and organisations working in old-age care for at least two years.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana
schemes.provides: Free physical aids and assistive devices for age-related disability or infirmity, distributed through ALIMCO camps.
schemes.named: Senior citizens aged 60 or above, holding Aadhaar, who are BPL or have a monthly income of not more than ₹15,000.

schemes.name: Elderline — National Helpline for Senior Citizens, 14567
schemes.provides: Free information, guidance, emotional support and field intervention in cases of abuse and rescue, in every State and UT.
schemes.named: All senior citizens.

schemes.name: Training of Geriatric Caregivers
schemes.provides: Certified training in geriatric care at medical and nursing colleges and NISD-affiliated institutes, to create a pool of professional caregivers.
schemes.named: Persons aged 18 or above with the qualification the job role requires.

schemes.umbrella: Umbrella Programme for Development of Other Vulnerable Groups
schemes.name: National Action Plan for Drug Demand Reduction and Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan
schemes.provides: Integrated Rehabilitation Centres for Addicts, Outreach and Drop-In Centres, District De-Addiction Centres and Addiction Treatment Facilities in government hospitals; the toll-free de-addiction helpline 14446; grant-in-aid to the voluntary organisations that run the centres.
schemes.named: Persons dependent on alcohol or drugs and their families; and NGOs running de-addiction and outreach centres.

schemes.name: SMILE — Comprehensive Rehabilitation of Persons Engaged in Begging
schemes.provides: Survey and identification, outreach and rescue, shelter homes with food, clothing, counselling and medical aid, and rehabilitation through education, skilling and self-employment; in 181 cities.
schemes.named: Persons engaged in begging, and their children.

schemes.name: SMILE — Comprehensive Rehabilitation for Welfare of Transgender Persons
schemes.provides: A certificate of identity through the National Portal for Transgender Persons; Garima Greh shelter homes; health cover under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY; skill development and entrepreneurship training; Transgender Protection Cells in the States.
schemes.named: Transgender persons holding a certificate of identity issued through the National Portal; and CBOs and NGOs able to run a shelter home.

schemes.name: PM-YASASVI Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
schemes.provides: A consolidated academic allowance of ₹4,000 a year, paid by direct benefit transfer.
schemes.named: OBC, EBC and DNT students in Class IX and X in Government schools, with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

schemes.name: PM-YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
schemes.provides: An academic allowance of ₹5,000 to ₹20,000 a year by category of course, for study after Class X.
schemes.named: OBC, EBC and DNT students at the post-matric stage, with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

schemes.name: PM-YASASVI Top Class School Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
schemes.provides: Tuition, hostel and other school charges up to ₹75,000 a year in Class 9 and 10 and ₹1,25,000 a year in Class 11 and 12, at shortlisted top schools; 30% of scholarships for girls.
schemes.named: OBC, EBC and DNT students admitted to a shortlisted school, with household income under ₹2.5 lakh; selected on the National Scholarship Portal merit list.

schemes.name: PM-YASASVI Top Class College Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
schemes.provides: Full tuition and non-refundable charges, living expenses of ₹3,000 a month, ₹5,000 a year for books, and a one-time laptop allowance of ₹45,000, at IIMs, IITs, AIIMS, NITs, NLUs and other notified institutions.
schemes.named: OBC, EBC and DNT students with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh admitted to a notified institution; 30% of slots for girl students.

schemes.name: Construction of Hostels for OBC Boys and Girls
schemes.provides: Central assistance to States, UTs and NIRF-ranked institutions to build hostels for OBC students near Government schools, colleges and universities.
schemes.named: OBC students from rural areas, through the institution or State that builds the hostel.

schemes.name: National Fellowship for OBC Students
schemes.provides: A Junior and Senior Research Fellowship at UGC rates for M.Phil. and Ph.D.; 1,000 fellowships a year, 750 in humanities and social sciences and 250 in science.
schemes.named: OBC students who have qualified UGC NET-JRF or UGC-CSIR NET-JRF.

schemes.name: Dr. Ambedkar Interest Subsidy on Education Loans for Overseas Studies for OBCs and EBCs
schemes.provides: The full interest for the moratorium period on an education loan of up to ₹20 lakh for a Master's, M.Phil. or Ph.D. abroad; half of the assistance reserved for women.
schemes.named: OBC candidates within the creamy-layer limit and EBC candidates with family income up to ₹5 lakh, admitted to an approved course abroad.

schemes.name: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of DNTs (SEED)
schemes.provides: Free coaching for competitive examinations; health insurance through Ayushman Bharat; livelihood support through self-help groups; and financial assistance for housing through PM Awas Yojana.
schemes.named: Members of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic communities holding a DNT certificate.

schemes.name: Special Scholarship under PM CARES for Children
schemes.provides: ₹20,000 a year for a child in Class 1 to 12: a monthly allowance of ₹1,000 and an academic allowance of ₹8,000 for fees, books, uniform and equipment.
schemes.named: Children who lost both parents, or their legal guardian or surviving parent, to COVID-19, identified by the District Magistrate under the PM CARES for Children scheme.

schemes.name: Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme
schemes.provides: Medical treatment for serious ailments requiring surgery of the kidney, heart, liver, brain, cancer or other life-threatening disease.
schemes.named: SC and ST patients with annual family income under ₹3 lakh.

schemes.name: Dr. Ambedkar National Merit Awards for Class 10 and Class 12
schemes.provides: Cash awards of ₹40,000 to ₹60,000 for the top three SC and ST students of each recognised Board in Class 10, with a separate award for the highest-scoring girl; awards for SC students in Class 12 in four streams.
schemes.named: SC and ST students who scored at least 50% in a recognised Board's secondary examination; SC students in the senior secondary examination.

schemes.name: e-Anudaan — Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations
schemes.provides: Online application, processing and sanction of grant-in-aid for five Department schemes, with NGO Darpan verification and PFMS payment.
schemes.named: Voluntary organisations registered on NGO Darpan applying under AVYAY, NAPDDR, SHRESHTA Mode II, SMILE and the Department's other grant schemes.
